scripts.typecheck: npm run types:worker && astro check --minimumFailingSeverity error && tsc --project tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json && tsc --project tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.build:owner: CLOUDFLARE_ENV= astro build && node scripts/verify-build-profile.mjs owner
scripts.build:playground: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=playground astro build && node scripts/verify-build-profile.mjs playground
scripts.preview: npm run build:owner && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:owner: env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN npm run secrets:check && npm run build:owner && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:owner:dry-run: npm run build:owner && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --dry-run
scripts.deploy:playground: npm run build:playground && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:playground:dry-run: npm run build:playground && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --dry-run
